projects.title: AI Investor – Multi-Agent Stock Trading System
description: Engineered a collaborative multi-agent trading system leveraging AI agents with expertise in technical indicators, candlestick patterns, risk analysis, and news sentiment.
Built decision consensus workflows and visual dashboards using Streamlit and backtested strategies with vectorbt.
challenges: Integrating multiple AI agents with different expertise
Ensuring real-time decision making in volatile markets
Managing risk across different trading strategies
solutions: Implemented collaborative agent architecture with LangChain
Built consensus mechanisms for decision making
Created comprehensive backtesting framework with vectorbt

results.title: Risk Management
results.description: Reduced portfolio risk by 40% through multi-agent consensus

results.title: Automation
results.description: Fully automated trading decisions with minimal human intervention

projects.title: LLM-Powered Research Assistant

Implementing semantic search across diverse content
Optimizing LLM performance for research queries
solutions: Used Qdrant for efficient vector storage and retrieval
Implemented Elasticsearch for full-text search capabilities
Optimized Ollama integration for local LLM processing

results.title: Research Speed
results.description: 10x faster research paper analysis and insights
